items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger cooling capacity than the damaged one)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9 and 7.1.10: Only a like-for-like replacement of the damaged 3.5 kW unit is indemnified; the upgrade to a 7.1 kW model is a non-covered improvement, so indemnity is capped at the cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW replacement. Reference Case 38 (similar fixed living-room unit, surge loss, t = 1352–1445 EUR incl. VAT).

Policy 7.1.9: Installation of a like-for-like replacement is covered, but only to the extent required for the equivalent 3.5 kW unit. Reference Case 38 (installation for living-room unit, t = 468–488 EUR incl. VAT).

items.description: Decorative floor console (chosen for room appearance, not required by the new unit)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10 and 3.5(d): Not indemnified, as it is an improvement for appearance, not required for installation or function. Reference Case 38 (floor console for living-room unit, t = 54–67 EUR, but only covered if required for installation; here, it is not).
Policy 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.12: Ordinary freight for the covered replacement is indemnified. Reference Case 38 (freight shipping, t = 40–43 EUR incl. VAT).
Policy 7.1.12: Surcharges for expedited/timed delivery are excluded unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert further loss, which is not indicated here.
Policy 7.1.8(b): General administrative/handling/processing charges are not indemnified, regardless of description. Reference Case 38 and others: admin fees always t = 0.
